_what: Decide whether to draft one capped preorder test for a product before buying stock, or wait until a specific prerequisite is verified.

payload.label: Plan a preorder test before buying stock
payload.job: Decide whether to draft one capped preorder test for a product before buying stock, or wait until a specific prerequisite is verified.
payload.produces: An internal test proposal with a paid-order threshold, delivery and cancellation terms, or a hold with the missing evidence and the next check.

source.author: Ryan Daniel Moran

references.title: How Bloggers Make Money Building BRANDS | How To Make Money Blogging
references.basis: Tells a product creator to talk to their existing audience while developing the product, build a waiting list, and invite preorders before the product is available. The example is a stroller.

references.title: 0 to $100K/Month in 12 Months (Step-by-Step Plan)
references.basis: Separates building a list of people ready to buy from launching to it. The card-game product example generated paid preorders before the first inventory order.

references.title: Telling 8 Entrepreneurs How to Build Their $1,000,000 Brand
references.basis: In a coaching answer, check whether a manufacturer can produce the product and what the test run would cost; only then offer the early run to the audience.

source.adapted_safeguards: The quantity rule, viability and delivery evidence, price and cancellation terms, and the instruction not to transact are safeguards for this draft, not claims about what every recording teaches.

steps.title: Set one batch test or wait
steps.do: In the same answer, name the product and the audience that has shown interest. Separate sign-ups and replies from valid paid orders: do not count interest, duplicate orders, cancellations, or refunded orders as demand met. Check a dated supplier quote, test-batch cost, delivery capacity, and the handling of cancellations or refunds. If any required evidence or terms are uncertain, choose wait, name the gap, and give the next check. Otherwise draft one small whole-batch test. Use the same positive quantity as both the maximum offered and the number of valid paid orders needed by the test deadline. Pick a quantity you can afford to make and fulfill at the quoted costs and price. State the unit price, test deadline, delivery and cancellation terms, and how missed demand will be handled without buying stock or keeping refundable money. Write an internal proposal only. Do not publish, contact buyers, take money, or order stock.
steps.done_when: The answer gives one internal proposal with the verified basis, terms, quantity and missed-target action, or the one gap to check before offering anything.
steps.why: An interested audience is not yet evidence of a paid order, and a paid order is not evidence that the seller can fill it.
